addition.item: «Symbols to keep»: symbols never removed as emoji or extra symbols; © ® ™ by default, extendable per site (☎ ✉ ★ …).

change.item: № and ≈ are no longer removed by default; an untouched 1.0.0 list moves to the new default on update.
An emptied «Extra symbols» field means «emoji only» instead of falling back to the default.

addition.item: Cleans article text on paste and on save: Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice and Telegram clutter, emoji, hashtags; keeps links, anchors, footnotes and allowed classes.
Video and social embeds are stored as safe markers and built into lazy-loaded iframes on the site by the plugin itself.
Kazakh language; settings of «The Tenge: text cleaning» are carried over on install.
